Then the buyer is written as a code and the property address is not written

  Scenario: AC10 A consumed call fails and nothing is committed (new, D-RCV-60)
    Given the rwb-document contract mock refuses the custody release
    When the title transfer branch runs
    Then nothing is committed and the step retries on the workflow schedule

  Scenario: AC11 A status change the model does not allow is refused (new, D-RCV-60)
    Given a case in a state other than TITLE_TRANSFER_PENDING
    When the title transfer branch runs
    Then the rule does not fire, nothing is written and the state is reported to the parent

  Scenario: AC12 An error answer is 401, 403 or 404 (new, D-RCV-60)
    Given a request without a valid login, a role without the right, or an asset that does not exist
    When the provided operation is called
    Then the answer is 401 without a login, 403 with MSG-P4-002 without the right, or 404 for an unknown asset

  Scenario: AC13 A timed-out or broken-circuit call commits nothing (new, D-RCV-60)
    Given the rwb-document contract mock does not answer inside 2 s or its breaker is open
    When the title transfer branch runs
    Then nothing is committed, the step retries on the workflow schedule and the caller sees 503
